onboarding.s1Body: POBO works with independent local partners to build trusted, structured knowledge of residential real estate. You represent your society and neighbourhood.
s1Points: Verified knowledge: you map real homes, towers and occupancy.
Trusted advisor: you guide buyers, sellers and renters through visits and fair negotiation, with zero spam.
onboarding.s2Body: You should always know what to do next:
s2Steps: Your action centre: what needs attention right now.
Customers and their requirements, each with a next action.
Map towers and flats in your society, then survey them.
Earnings unlock only after the customer fee is received and reconciled.
onboarding.s3Body: Customer trust is POBO's most important asset:
s3Points: Customer numbers are protected. Ask permission before you record anyone's contact details.
If someone says no or asks not to be contacted (DNC), respect it immediately. The app will stop calls, messages and follow-ups for them.
Never share customer details, floor data or negotiations outside POBO.
onboarding.s4Body: Standards for every active Area Ambassador:
s4Points: Record information accurately and say when it is unverified.
Do NOT promise a price, discount or closure POBO has not approved.
Do NOT create fake surveys, dummy properties or made-up leads.
Do NOT take side brokerage or move deals off POBO.
